verdict.rationale: Kling documents a built-in Agent that users converse with to brainstorm, write scripts, and generate images, videos, and storyboards, then refine and edit videos over multiple rounds. That is natural-language operation of the product itself. It also offers MCP/CLI access so a user's own agent can drive Kling, and its core generation is prompt-driven text-to-video and text-to-image. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of which product functions the Agent can perform via commands (e.g. settings, project management, export), and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing blurbs.
